properties.name: Reserve outer boundary (2023 extent, as far as public files draw it)
properties.reliability: Official files joined; about 180 km² of the notified reserve has no public map and is not included.
properties.method: Union of the Forest Department's reserve file (2013 extent), its national park and sanctuary files, the Bhainsrorgarh WLS file and the whole 2023 buffer blocks drawn in the Kota district file. Holes under 0.01 km² that only appear where two files' edges miss each other are filled.
properties.instrument: Rajasthan Forest Department notification F.3(8)Forest/2012, 9 Apr 2013; Rajasthan Forest Department notification F.3(22)Forest/2023, 5 Oct 2023

properties.disclaimer: Reconstructed from Rajasthan Forest Department map files for reference. Not a legal or cadastral boundary: the reserve is defined by the schedules and boundary descriptions in the notifications. The Forest Department marks its files as for management use, not legal purposes.
properties.gaps: Not included because no public file draws them: the 2023 buffer part-blocks and compartments in Kota and Bundi, the National Chambal buffer piece, and 21 revenue villages near Rawatbhata (about 180 km² of the notified 1,135.79 km²). The village enclaves inside the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary file are left open, as that file draws them; OpenStreetMap points for ten of the 21 villages fall inside them. A 6.2 km² area around Daulatpura that no reserve file includes is also left open (the 2020 ESZ file covers most of it).
